messages:
Jared (Infra): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: people asked about APAC GA vs pilot and autoscaler defaults for Dedicated pools.
Mina (Product): Short summary: pilot = late Q3, GA depends on procurement and pilot feedback. Dedicated customers can opt for reserved_nodes to avoid cross-region fallback.
Liam (SRE): Autoscaler default behavior for Hosted: warm_pool=0, burst_multiplier=1.5, burst_window=180s. Dedicated defaults include warm_pool>0 for enterprise SKUs.
Priya (Sales): Customers want a simple doc that says: if APAC runs out of GPUs we either (A) use warm pool, (B) route cross-region, or (C) block requests if reserved_nodes are exhausted. Need clear latency numbers.
Jared (Infra): Example snippet we share with SEs:
```
autoscaler:
  warm_pool: 3
  burst_multiplier: 2
  burst_window_s: 120
  fallback: cross_region
```
Liam (SRE): Monitoring we'll add: apac_free_gpus, apac_warm_pool_usage, cross_region_routes. Alert if free_gpus < 10% for >5m.
Mina (Product): Action items: (1) Jared to draft a 1-page routing + SLA doc (ETA Wed), (2) Priya to collect pilot customer list and priority needs (ETA Tue), (3) Liam to PR dashboard panels (ETA Thu).
record-bot: Recording + slides uploaded: https://redwood.slack-recordings/1851234567 :page_with_curl:
Priya (Sales): Noted. I'll drop names in the pilot sheet today.
Jared (Infra): I'll post the draft doc in #eng-infra and link here when done. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
file_notes: Short all-hands follow-up clarifying APAC pilot timing, Dedicated vs Hosted autoscaler defaults, small config snippet, monitoring and action items.
